== Ingredients ==
* 1 can (397 g / 14 oz) [[Cookbook:Mandarin Orange|Mandarin oranges]] (including syrup)
* 2 frozen [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (160 g / 5.6 oz) frozen [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]]
* 1 ½ cups (375 ml / 12.7 oz) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
== Procedure ==

# Add all ingredients to a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] in the order listed above.
# Hold down the lid, and blend on low speed for 30 seconds.
# Blend on high speed for 1 minute.
# Pour into a glass and enjoy.
